subject: [PATCH v2 1/3] mm: swap: move LRU insertion out of the swap cache allocator

2026-07-27.patch_summary: This patch moves the insertion of a folio into the LRU (Least Recently Used) list out of the swap cache allocator. The swap cache allocator is used by zswap writeback to allocate a folio that can be freed directly once writeback completes, without being on the LRU. This change does not introduce any functional changes and only modifies the internal implementation details of the swap cache allocator.
